card_name_eng: Attack of the Heavy Mobile Digimon!
effect_description_eng: [Main] You may trash 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait from your hand to have all of your level 6 Digimon with the [Machine] trait gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and "[On Play] If this Digimon has a digivolution card, ＜Blitz＞"" for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may trash 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait in your hand to delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose play cost less than or equal to the trashed card's play cost.
